recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, square-framed portrait of three individuals set against a large, solid-colored background with a matte texture. The typography is stacked at the top, overlapping the frame edge, utilizing a mix of bold serif and flowing script styles in a monochromatic earth-tone palette.
coreVisualRelationships: The thin golden frame creates a window effect within the larger tan canvas.
The subjects' clothing colors (black, brown, patterned charcoal) anchor the warm background tones.
The large script title overlaps the top border of the inner frame to create depth.
Soft, hazy lighting in the photograph contrasts with the flat, solid color of the outer border.
coreInvariants: A thick, uniform outer border in a muted tan or ochre color.
A thin, rounded-corner inner frame separating the image from the border.
A centered three-person composition with the central figure slightly forward.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are waist-up, centered horizontally, occupying roughly 60% of the total height within the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the black hat and dress acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large script title at the top, down through the central figure, then outward to the flanking figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the thick outer border and the hazy, bright background within the photo.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark browns (clothing and hair).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a warm, yellow-red bias; high value contrast between the subjects and the bright photo background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of a high-contrast modern serif and a thick, fluid brush script.
letterConstructionRules: Top line: High-contrast serif with sharp terminals and thin hairlines.
Bottom line: Heavy-weight script with a slight italic slant and rounded terminals.
Tight letter spacing with intentional overlaps.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the script title is oversized and serves as a base for the text above it.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, elegant serif is stacked directly above a large, bold script for a vintage editorial look.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the soft, vintage weight required for the display text.
Captures the mid-century fluid script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of three people (two men, one woman in a hat) standing in a hazy, sun-bleached field. The image is contained within a thin, rounded-corner gold frame, which is itself centered on a large, solid matte tan background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text at the top. The top line is a small, elegant serif. The bottom line is a very large, bold script in a cream color that slightly overlaps the top edge of the inner frame.

verificationChecks: Is the outer border a solid, muted earth tone?
Does the script text overlap the inner frame line?
Is the lighting in the photo hazy and warm?

adjustableVariables: Curvature of the inner frame corners
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background.
Check that the frame corners are consistently rounded.
Verify the color palette remains strictly within earth tones.
Confirm the subjects are centered and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered framed portrait + thick solid border + stacked serif/script typography overlapping the frame.
